test_vectorized_func: test the vectorized_func to apply a C++ function element-wise across NumPy arrays with broadcasting
test_type_selection: test the selective_func to dispatch different branches based on NumPy array dtype
test_trivial_broadcasting: test vectorized_is_trivial to detect whether NumPy array broadcasting is C-trivial, F-trivial, or non-trivial
test_passthrough_arguments: test vec_passthrough to mix vectorized NumPy arguments with scalar and non-vectorized passthrough arguments
test_method_vectorization: test method vectorization on a class instance to apply vectorized calls to object methods
